articles.title: Zero-trust networking for agentic AI with Amazon VPC Lattice
articles.summary: Amazon VPC Lattice enables zero-trust networking for AI agents, providing secure data access and protection.
articles.detail: Amazon VPC Lattice is a new service that provides zero-trust networking for AI agents, allowing them to securely access data without compromising security. This service is designed to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access.

articles.title: How WeatherBug reduced storage costs by 80% using Amazon S3 Storage Lens and Kiro CLI
articles.summary: WeatherBug reduced its storage costs by 80% using Amazon S3 Storage Lens and Kiro CLI, optimizing data management.
articles.detail: WeatherBug was able to significantly reduce its storage costs by leveraging Amazon S3 Storage Lens and Kiro CLI. This optimization enabled the company to better manage its data and reduce expenses.

articles.title: The Economics of Agent Optimization: From pilots to measurable returns
articles.summary: Microsoft Azure provides a framework for optimizing AI agent costs, enabling businesses to achieve measurable returns.
articles.detail: Microsoft Azure's economics of agent optimization framework helps businesses move from pilot projects to measurable ROI. This approach enables companies to optimize their AI investments and achieve tangible results.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Live Resize for Shared Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Data Disks
articles.summary: Azure introduces live resize capability for shared premium SSD v2 and ultra data disks, enhancing storage flexibility.
articles.detail: Azure's new live resize feature enables customers to dynamically expand their storage capacity without disrupting applications. This enhancement provides greater flexibility in managing storage resources.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Pre-upgrade validation checks for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
articles.summary: Azure introduces pre-upgrade validation checks for PostgreSQL flexible servers, ensuring seamless database upgrades.
articles.detail: Azure's new pre-upgrade validation checks enable customers to proactively validate major version upgrade readiness for their PostgreSQL flexible servers. This feature ensures a smooth upgrade process and minimizes downtime.

articles.detail: The partnership aims to develop local AI talent in Indonesia through the establishment of a university-based AI center. This initiative will drive AI innovation and adoption in the region.

articles.title: Monitoring beyond SNMP: Turning your network into a sensor
articles.summary: Cisco introduces advanced monitoring capabilities, enabling networks to become sensors for AI-driven insights.
articles.detail: Cisco's new monitoring features go beyond traditional SNMP-based monitoring. This advancement enables networks to become sensors, providing rich telemetry data that can be leveraged for AI-driven insights and optimization.
